title: D4: Planner session rules — restart at 150k context via handover, one notification per wait, no forks, trimmed tool output
spec: Why: the 2026-09-18 session ran 411 turns to a 446k-token context; 112 monitor notifications were each a full turn; the rules said restart at 60 percent of the window, which is far too late. Text-only change in the Planner's own rules, kept byte-identical where duplicated: CLAUDE.md Always item 9 becomes "At 150k context tokens (or after 150 turns): `uv run orchestrator handover --reason context`, then restart the session on the account `orchestrator pick planner` names." Add to CLAUDE.md Never: "Fork this session or spawn an Agent that inherits its context; spawn fresh workers." Add to both orchestrate SKILL.md copies and skills/planner/resume/SKILL.md: waiting rule (one Monitor per wait with an exit condition on the final state, never per status change; no polling), tool-output rule (head, cut, jq; never cat a file over 200 lines; scout results read once), and the review policy from D1 in one line. Also update the planner-mode text in .orchestrator/prompts/planner.md (C-O3 v3) so the headless Planner carries the same rules. Tests: tests/test_hooks.py (or test_pool.py) asserts the two orchestrate SKILL.md copies are identical and that CLAUDE.md contains the 150k rule.
acceptance: CLAUDE.md, both orchestrate SKILL.md copies, resume SKILL.md and prompts/planner.md carry the new rules; a test asserts the SKILL.md copies are identical and CLAUDE.md contains '150k'
No other file changed; `uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` green
